issue.description:
ADR-002 replaces cross-tool migration with agent-guided rehydration, which must produce a reconciliation report mapping every source identifier to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, recording the source repository and commit. No format, schema, or location for that report is specified in any supplied document, so rehydrations performed by different agents are inconsistent and hard to review. Define a versioned report format (disposition vocabulary, per-source-id mapping, required source provenance), document it alongside the field guide, and include a minimal example so rehydration work across repositories is comparable and reviewable.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Define a versioned reconciliation-report format for agent-guided rehydration
